title: Being Generous with Time, Not Just Money
paragraphs: Known among friends for donating generously to charity, Zulkifli realized one day that he rarely gave anything as valuable as his actual time, always preferring to simply write a check instead.
When a friend's mother fell seriously ill, Zulkifli decided to visit the hospital regularly, sitting with the family during difficult hours rather than only sending money to help with expenses.
His friend later admitted that the visits meant more to the family than any financial contribution could have, since presence during hardship carried a weight that money alone rarely provides.
Reflecting on the experience, Zulkifli started balancing his usual financial generosity with more personal, time-based giving, realizing that true generosity often costs more than money alone.
